recognition: 운영사별 홀드율 분모와 연결 범위를 유지. 월별 게임 실적이 전체 연결 매출을 대체하지 않음.
4개 분기 합산. 실제 분기 0/4. 부분 집계 제외.
bridge: 3% base payroll/contract inflation with 2% efficiency and 6% pressure cases. Apply to calibrated seasonally matched fixed-cost residual, not every cost line.
Q2 IR states acquired Hyatt sales8.0bn; hold same contribution base and stress±2bn, added only to comparable pre-acquisition noncasino baseline. Not guidance.
Organic hotel/fun-city revenue growth excluding the separately modeled acquisition uplift. Apply to same-quarter2025 noncasino residual.
Base follows matched July-August 2026/2025 drop growth; ±10 percentage point stress applies only to September. Hold remains a separate assumption.

Normalized yield assumption, differentiated by operator/denominator. Historical complete-quarter weighted hold and July/August volatility retained in official_evidence.calibration; scenarios are judgments, not statistical confidence intervals.

Reduced-form operating cost elasticity (casino-related variable operating costs / casino revenue). GKL28% approximates latest comps+promotion+tourism fund+excise share; Paradise32% and Lotte35% are explicit scenario modeling judgments with residual calibration. Kangwon28.2% is applied to casino gross operating revenue and comes from company IR levy rates, not to net revenue.
Base carries latest matched July-August drop growth into same-quarter 2025 baseline; ±10pp scenario. This is a volume assumption, not simple revenue growth.
Same as Q3 acquisition bridge. Hyatt costs stay within fixed residual calibration, avoiding margin-free revenue.
Volume growth scenario after hold normalization. Base assumes moderate tourism/recovery; bear weak inbound or renovation disruption; bull sustained visit/spend growth. No company guidance asserted.
Net noncasino segment growth. No hotel gross revenue is added where already in integrated resort or internal elimination.
next_steps: 대사 차이를 원문 버전·범위·가정별로 확인 후 추정 갱신
